question: After recovering from an infectious illness, often small pox, Brita dance is typically performed to thank the local deity. It is one of the most well - known dances of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Brita dance** is a traditional dance form of **West Bengal **that is performed to** thank the local deity** after recovering from an** infectious illness, typically smallpox.**
 
• The dance is performed by **women in a circle** around a pitcher filled with water, and they **sprinkle the water** on each other to** symbolize purification** and renewal.
 
• The dance is accompanied by **traditional Bengali music **and is an important part of the local culture and tradition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **West Bengal** is also known for other famous dance forms such as **Chhau, Gaudiya Nritya, and Rabindra Nritya.**
 
• **Bihar **is known for other famous dance forms such as **Jat Jatin and Jhumar.**
 
• The major folk dances of **Uttar Pradesh** are** Charkula, ****Raslila****, Kathak, Ramlila, Khyal, Nautanki, Dadra, and Kajri Dance.**
 
• Some folk and tribal dances in** Jharkhand **are **Jhumair, Mardana Jhumair, Janani Jhumair, Domkach, Lahasua, Jhumta, Fagua, Paika, Chhau, Firkal, Mundari and Santali.**
